title: Modern Lakefront Villa
description: Stunning 4-bedroom villa with panoramic lake views, infinity pool, and a chef's kitchen. Floor-to-ceiling windows flood every room with natural light. Smart home technology throughout.

title: Downtown Luxury Penthouse
description: Exclusive penthouse with wraparound terrace in the heart of downtown. Features include marble finishes, private elevator, wine cellar, and stunning skyline views from every room.

title: Charming Craftsman Bungalow
description: Beautifully restored 1920s craftsman with original hardwood floors, built-in bookshelves, and a wraparound porch. Updated kitchen and bathrooms while preserving historic charm.

title: Sleek Urban Apartment
description: Contemporary 2-bedroom apartment in a boutique building with rooftop pool and fitness center. Open floor plan, quartz countertops, and in-unit laundry. Walking distance to restaurants and nightlife.

title: Hill Country Estate
description: Sprawling 5-bedroom estate on 3 acres with Hill Country views. Features include a resort-style pool, outdoor kitchen, guest casita, and a 3-car garage. Custom-built in 2021.

title: Cozy Starter Home
description: Perfect starter home in a family-friendly neighborhood. 3 bedrooms, updated kitchen with granite counters, fenced backyard, and a 2-car garage. Close to top-rated schools.

title: Waterfront Condo with Marina Access
description: Beautifully appointed 2-bedroom condo with direct marina access and lake views. Features include a boat slip, community pool, and private balcony overlooking the water.

title: New Construction Modern Farmhouse
description: Brand new 4-bedroom modern farmhouse with open concept living, shiplap accents, and a large covered patio. Energy-efficient with solar panels and smart home features.

title: Luxury High-Rise Studio
description: Elegant studio in a premier high-rise with concierge service, rooftop lounge, and panoramic city views. Italian tile floors, built-in Murphy bed, and a walk-in closet.

title: Ranch Property with Acreage
description: Beautiful 20-acre ranch with a renovated 3-bedroom farmhouse, barn, and riding arena. Fenced and cross-fenced with a pond and mature oak trees. Ag-exempt.

title: Mid-Century Modern Gem
description: Meticulously updated mid-century modern home with an open floor plan, vaulted ceilings, and walls of glass. Mature landscaping and a saltwater pool in a prime location.

title: Family-Friendly Townhome
description: Spacious 3-bedroom townhome with an attached garage and private backyard. Community amenities include pool, playground, and walking trails. Move-in ready with new appliances.

title: Vacant Lot in Prime Location
description: 0.5-acre lot in a gated community with hill country views. Utilities available at the lot line. Build your dream home with no timeline restrictions. HOA with community amenities.

title: Renovated Victorian Home
description: Stunning Victorian home with period details including stained glass windows, ornate woodwork, and a turret. Fully renovated with modern systems while honoring the original character.
